name: ronin-skills
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for framework-agnostic AI coding agent discipline: research, planning, self-checks, completion verification, git/CI/dev-server/pnpm/socket/no-bash/obey discipline (agent plugin), plus optional bash-tool enforcement hooks (hooks plugin).

plugins.name: agent
plugins.description: AI coding agent discipline: research, planning, self-checks, completion verification, git/CI workflow, package-manager and security rules. Skills only; install the hooks plugin for enforcement. Requires superpowers plugin.

plugins.name: hooks
plugins.description: Optional Bash-tool and workflow enforcement hooks for the agent plugin: no-bash, no-absolute-paths, force-plan-mode, auto-formatter, no-honest. Install to opt into enforcement. Requires agent@ronin-skills.
